The '''Reibrin system''', in the [[Ansuroer sector/Legends|Ansuroer sector]], contained [[Lijuter]], the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it also contained several Imperial research stations on Lijuter's second [[Moon/Legends|moon]], the site of Imperial experiments which attempted to turn Houk subjects into "perfect [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]." Several space stations also orbited this moon.
